notes.title: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer - Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Bug fix update to added translations in 1.2.0 patch: https://steamcommunity.com/games/2069040/announcements/detail/4271182997378712696?snr=2___

Translation Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that would cause some UI text elements to be invisible in certain circumstances.
- Improved design of the translation bubble that appears under some puzzles.
- Resolved visual glitch with the "disarm" button.
- Corrected out-of-bounds labels in the true/false puzzle (Russian language).
- Added missing title translation in the moving puzzle on the last level.
- Included the missing word "nie" in the true/false puzzle (Polish language).

New Features:
- Added an Easter egg in Polish language – a reference to a classic Polish movie. Up to you to find it!

notes.title: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Updates:

* Added additional game servers to address location-related connectivity issues.
* Improved UI for selecting the starting level.
* Introduced support for various fullscreen modes.
* Enriched the game with more one-liners from the main characters.

Bug Fixes:

* Resolved a bug on Android where, under certain conditions, the game would crash on level 4.
* Addressed synchronization issues between audio and visuals in the cutscenes.
* Corrected a bug where a picture would briefly flash at the beginning of the intro.
* Fixed an issue where part of a clue was not visible on iPads.
